title: Ujwalam user profile (streamer + per-game names)
description: Validates data/profile.example.json (placeholders) and the gitignored data/profile.local.json (real values). Supersedes the data/games/<game-id>/profile.json location in the game-event-detection amendment: user values live in one profile file, detector packs live in data/games/<game-id>/detectors.json. Every string in the local file is a private term for the git hooks.

games.description: Keyed by game id; the id selects data/games/<id>/detectors.json.

brand.description: Local brand asset files used by scene presets ({brand.*} placeholders).

handles.description: Display handles shown on stream by scene presets ({handles.*} placeholders).

bots.description: Optional WebSocket address of Streamer.bot and Speaker.bot, on this machine only (services/bots). Leave out for the defaults: a value in this file becomes a private term for the git hooks, so a default address written here would block commits of the code that holds the same default.

links.description: Display links shown on stream by scene presets ({links.*} placeholders).

issues_url.description: Private repo for the Report button (services/studio-ui/report.mjs): exactly https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>, no trailing slash, path, query or fragment. Local profile only: it names the account.

devices.description: Optional device role overrides for the alpha scene build (services/project/device-roles.mjs). Without an override a role is matched to the registry device presets (registry/presets/device-*.json params.match). Every string here becomes a private term for the git hooks, so prefer the device path from devices.list over the name.

monitoringOutput.description: Audio monitoring output: where sources set to monitor play (headphones). name = the Windows output's friendly name as devices.list shows it (kind audio-output). Without it libobs uses the Windows default output. Applied only with --allow-devices.

deviceBinding.description: Exactly one of: path (the devices.list path, matched case-insensitively) or name (the exact devices.list name).

variants.description: Clan tags, separator-glyph variants and common OCR misreads of the IGN.
